source.title: WAC Leader Announcement (September 2024)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Rui Reis will become the new Leader of the WCA Appeals Committee (WAC)

Rui was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. The promotion is active as of 14 September 2024.

We thank Stone Amsbaugh for the work he has done for the WEC and as interim leader of WAC, and wish Rui best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Rui was the only applicant for the role, and his successful candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1m5dp7wZxJv8wiUPGprrEDh8cJL_bnk_l/view).

translation.title: WCA 申诉委员会负责人任命公告（2024 年 9 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Rui Reis 将担任 WCA 申诉委员会（WAC）的新负责人。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节，WCA 董事会选定 Rui，并通过投票批准任命。任命自 2024 年 9 月 14 日起生效。

感谢 Stone Amsbaugh 为 WEC 以及在代理 WAC 负责人期间所做的工作，祝 Rui 履新顺利。

Rui 是本次岗位的唯一申请人。他的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1m5dp7wZxJv8wiUPGprrEDh8cJL_bnk_l/view)查看。
